acceptance.criterion: Decode the complete raw take and record actual dimensions, FPS, duration, audio, original bytes and settled cost without substituting an estimate.
Full 1x playback shows stable fish anatomy, genuine forward propulsion and gradual physically correct emergence/occlusion, with a substantial visible middle swim.
At least four full plays show three consecutive joins without fish pop-in, exposure reset, abrupt leaf velocity reversal, held endpoint or artificial backward return.
Protected top bar and orientation-specific reading zones remain usable; the complete visible fish stays inside actual desktop, narrow-phone and phone-landscape crops.
Record technical checks, coordinator visual judgment and human creative acceptance separately. Static inputs and a ready shot plan are not film approval or paid authorization.

constraints.camera: One fixed-camera uninterrupted underwater view, same framing at both endpoints. No cut, zoom, pan or reframing. Plan FPS is a delivery target, not a claim about ungenerated provider output.
constraints.character: One modest silver-and-black freshwater angelfish; entirely concealed at the endpoints, recognizable intact body, eyes and complete fine fins during the visible middle swim. No exact visible pose reset.
constraints.environment: Quiet shaded left reading region, detailed right middle-distance root-and-leaf concealment pocket and an open swimming corridor inside the crop.
constraints.lighting: Stable restrained underwater daylight with quiet live-copy regions. Environmental highlights may move gently, but no seam flash or exposure pumping.
constraints.materials: Preserve realistic leaf surfaces, coherent root/wood geometry and layered water depth. No ghost fish, melting plants or artificial cutouts.
constraints.motion: Around 1s emerge progressively through the real root opening, swim a short relaxed forward arc during the middle, turn into depth and be fully concealed behind the same root/leaves by the final second. Water and leaves remain alive across the join. No backward slide, held frame or visible forced return.
